Anya P.: Hey team — quick ask: customer-facing rollout tomorrow requires 2 extra engineers to be able to trigger prod deploys for the hotfix window. What's the process to grant temporary prod deploy access? We need MFA and audit trail.
Marc S.: Short answer: we use JIT access via the deployer role. We allow up to 4h with enforced MFA. Need an approver from EngOps and a Jira ticket linking names + commit SHA.
Owen L.: +1 on no long-lived perms. If possible, use per-release access rather than group changes.
Anya P.: What's the exact command/flow? @deploy-bot can you show the JIT request format?
deploy-bot: To request JIT deploy access run:
```
/request-deploy-access --env=prod --duration=4h --reason="hotfix for payment flow" --approver=@Ops-Oncall --users="anya@example.com,dev1@example.com"
```
Request creates a ticket and emits an approval event to the approver's inbox.
Jia R.: Compliance note: ticket must list full user emails and the exact commit SHA. Also add 'rollback_policy' in the ticket body.
Ops-Oncall: I can approve but only if 2FA is verified on their SSO sessions and the ticket has the names + SHA. I'll aim to approve by 09:15 PT tomorrow morning; ping me if not.
Marc S.: FYI the pipeline enforces claim mfa:true for prod-deployer sessions. Any session without MFA will be rejected at policy-check.
Lena (PM): Timeline is tight; prefer avoiding SSO group edits. Can we operate entirely with JIT requests for this release?
Owen L.: Yes. Alternatively, we could create a short-lived service account, but that hurts traceability. Not recommended.
Anya P.: Plan: I'll open JIRA INC-3421 with the list of engineers + commit SHA, request 4h JIT via /request-deploy-access, approver @Ops-Oncall. If approved, we'll run the deploy 10:00-12:00 PT. @deploy-bot please attach the runbook link in the ticket.
deploy-bot: Runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/prod-deploy. Note: rollbacks must be done via a follow-up ticket with rollback=true and the same approver chain.
Ops-Oncall: Sounds good. I'll approve once the ticket is created and checks pass. One more ask: pin the operator's laptop serials in the ticket for audit.
Anya P.: Will do. Thanks all :thumbsup:
